Title: Name changes: Azure SQL Database long-term backup retention

Body.Content:
Effective June 1, 2018, names for long-term backup retention will change from “LTR RA-GRS Backup Storage” to “LTR Backup Storage.” There won’t be a pricing impact from this change, but you will need to modify billing routines that rely on names.
